QUICK STUDY GUIDE

Glossary of terms

Search for important words and their meanings.

Browser

A software application used to access and display websites.

CSS

A stylesheet language used to control the appearance and layout of web pages.

Data

Raw facts, figures, or symbols that can be processed.

Hardware

The physical components of a computer system.

HTML

The markup language used to structure content on web pages.

Information

Data that has been processed and organized to be meaningful.

JavaScript

A programming language commonly used to add interactivity to websites.

LAN

A local area network connecting devices within a limited area.

Operating system

System software that manages hardware and provides services for applications.

Server

A computer or program that provides resources or services to other devices.

Software

Programs and instructions that tell a computer what to do.

URL

The address used to locate a resource on the web.

Wi-Fi

Wireless networking technology used to connect devices to a local network.
